facts.text: The party must bring metal from the Dwarven mine to Warwick the smith in exchange for the loan of his mithril chain shirt. Meanwhile Warwick keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre and holds the party's plate armor as collateral.

Wayman wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt, on loan under the deal and due back to Warwick. It greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells. Ingrid says it was Warwick's grandfather's armor and he never let anyone touch it.
A cave-in seals the Dwarven mine entrance and blocks getting metal for Warwick. It looks natural and can be dug through; Dunk has started breaking into it.
